description: This file defines an interface 'ITlsApplicationProtocolFeature' in the namespace Orleans.Connections.Security. The interface includes a property for accessing the application protocol as a read-only memory of bytes.

classes.name: ITlsApplicationProtocolFeature
classes.description: An interface that exposes the TLS application protocol information, specifically the ApplicationProtocol property.

methods.name: ApplicationProtocol
methods.description: A property returning a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> representing the application protocol used in TLS.
